blocks.prompt: 10 A bank offers a compound interest rate of 10% per year. Zafar invests Rs. 2,000,000 for 4 years. How much will his investment be worth at the end of 4 years?
blocks.explanation:
10% compound interest ka matlab hai ke har saal raqam \(1 + 0.1\) se multiply hoti hai, kyunke interest bhi agle saal interest kamata hai.
4 saal baad: \(A = P(1 + 0.1)^4\). Binomial theorem \((1 + 0.1)^4\) ko bilkul exact khol deta hai (sirf 5 terms).
Plan: expand, jama, aur principal se multiply.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: principal \(P = \text{Rs. } 2{,}000{,}000\), rate \(10\% = 0.1\) saalana, waqt 4 saal.
Humein find karna hai: 4 saal baad kul raqam.
Tareeqa: Compound interest ka formula \(A = P(1 + r)^n\), jis mein \((1 + r)^n\) ko binomial theorem se kholenge. Calculator ke bagair bhi yeh hisaab aasaani se ho jata hai.

Formula likhein
\[A = 2{,}000{,}000\,(1 + 0.1)^4\]
Kyun: Har saal ka interest raqam mein jud jata hai, to har saal raqam 1.1 guna hoti hai. Chaar saal yani chaar dafa 1.1.

\((1 + 0.1)^4\) expand karein
\[= 1 + 4(0.1) + 6(0.1)^2\]
\[+ 4(0.1)^3 + (0.1)^4\]
\[= 1 + 0.4 + 0.06 + 0.004 + 0.0001\]
\[= 1.4641\]
Kyun: Pascal's triangle ki row 4: 1, 4, 6, 4, 1. \(n = 4\) positive integer hai, is liye expansion 5 terms par khatam ho jati hai aur jawab andaza nahi, bilkul exact hai.

Principal se multiply karein
\[A = 2{,}000{,}000 \times 1.4641\]
\[= 2{,}928{,}200\]
Kyun: \(2{,}000{,}000 \times 1.4641 = 2 \times 1{,}464{,}100\).
Dhyan dein: Simple interest wala jawab \(2{,}000{,}000 \times 1.4 = 2{,}800{,}000\) ghalat hoga; compound mein interest par bhi interest milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[2{,}000{,}000 \to 2{,}200{,}000\]
\[\to 2{,}420{,}000 \to 2{,}662{,}000\]
\[\to 2{,}928{,}200\]
Kyun: Saal ba saal 10% jorte gaye: pehle saal 200,000, doosre 220,000, teesre 242,000, chauthe 266,200. Aakhir mein wohi raqam aayi.
blocks.final_answer: 4 saal baad Zafar ki investment Rs. 2,928,200 ho jayegi.
